biggest_catch: The $100 credit requires 1,500+ kWh every single billing cycle — most months below that earn nothing.
catches: No credit below 1,500 kWh — high usage threshold.
12-month fixed-rate term with early termination fee.
The credit reduces the bill; it is savings on planned energy spending, not cash.
